title: Checklist do farm (perfeito)
concept: A soft clay checklist ticks itself one item per lofi beat (DrawSVG ticks, progress bar, smooth list scroll) from 'Caça sozinho' to the punchline 'Você dormindo', then rewinds to frame 1 for a seamless loop.
claims: alarmes no celular e notificações no WhatsApp

notes: Concept said 'the list folds into a tiny card that becomes frame 1'; implemented as a rewind (untick wave + scroll back to the top), which matches frame 0 exactly. To respect ≤14 words per screen, the 8 items scroll in a 5-row window (max 13 words visible incl. title). Added a small 'KizuBot' tag on the card for an early brand cue.
